question:
Which of the following is correct regarding Conditions of Governor's office?

I. The Governor can hold any other office of profit.

II. The Governor shall be entitled without payment of rent to the use of his official residences.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Condition II** is correct: The Governor shall be entitled without payment of rent to the use of his official residences.
 
• **Condition I** is incorrect: The Governor cannot hold any other office of profit during his term of office.
